style_context: Wilderness survival skills in diverse outdoor environments — forests, mountains, snow, desert, and waterways. Scouts learning and practicing backcountry emergency preparedness.

images.description: Two teenagers in clean Scout uniforms working together at a backcountry campsite clearing. One is arranging branches for a lean-to shelter frame while the other examines a topographic map. Dense mixed forest surrounds the clearing with distant mountain ridges visible through a gap in the trees. Late afternoon golden light filters through the canopy. Ground shows natural forest floor debris. No text, logos, or branding visible anywhere in the image.

Four-panel split showing contrasting wilderness environments. Top-left: snow-covered mountain peaks with evergreen forest below. Top-right: arid desert landscape with red sandstone formations and sparse vegetation. Bottom-left: dense deciduous forest with a winding trail and dappled sunlight. Bottom-right: rocky lakeshore with calm water reflecting surrounding cliffs. Each panel fills its quadrant completely. Dramatic natural lighting in each scene. No text, labels, or annotations.

Clean infographic with eight icons arranged in two rows of four on a warm tan background. Row one: red medical cross icon for first aid, thermometer icon for survival priorities, brain icon for mindset, backpack icon for kits. Row two: simple lean-to shelter icon for shelter, orange campfire flame icon for fire, starburst flash icon for signaling, blue water droplet icon for water. Each icon is a simple flat design with a short one-word label beneath it. Minimal design with generous spacing. No title header or border.

Vertical infographic showing four stages of hypothermia arranged top to bottom alongside a large thermometer graphic. Stage one at top labeled Mild with symptoms: shivering, cold hands, numb fingers. Stage two labeled Moderate with symptoms: violent shivering, confusion, slurred speech. Stage three labeled Severe with symptoms: shivering stops, loss of coordination, drowsiness. Stage four at bottom labeled Critical with symptoms: unconsciousness, weak pulse, shallow breathing. Temperature ranges shown on the thermometer. Color gradient from yellow at top to deep blue at bottom. Clean layout with simple icons for each stage.

Educational identification chart in a clean 2x2 grid layout. Top-left: black widow spider shown from above with shiny black body and red hourglass marking on abdomen clearly visible. Top-right: brown recluse spider shown from above with violin-shaped marking on its back highlighted. Bottom-left: bark scorpion in tan color with segmented tail curled upward, showing pincers and stinger. Bottom-right: copperhead snake coiled showing distinctive hourglass-shaped copper and brown banding pattern. Each creature rendered in detailed natural-history illustration style with subtle shadow. Short label beneath each creature identifying it. White background with thin border around each panel.

Flat-lay photograph of the Scout Essentials spread neatly on a weathered wooden picnic table. Items arranged in a grid pattern: folding pocketknife, small red first aid kit pouch, folded fleece layer and rain jacket, LED headlamp, trail mix bag and energy bars, metal water bottle, waterproof match case and ferro rod, sunscreen tube and sunglasses, folded topographic map with baseplate compass on top. Natural daylight. Clean organized arrangement with space between each item. No text or labels in the image.

Close-up photograph of a compact personal survival kit opened on a flat rock outdoors. Small waterproof hard case with lid open revealing organized contents: ferro rod with striker, small signal mirror, orange emergency whistle, coiled paracord, folded silver space blanket, small bottle of water purification tablets, duct tape wrapped around a short pencil, and a folded heavy-duty trash bag. Items fit snugly in the case. Forest background blurred. Natural light.

A teenager in a clean Scout uniform sitting at a dining room table with an adult family member. Both are looking at a topographic map spread on the table. The Scout holds a pencil and has a printed trip plan form partially filled out. A phone showing a weather app sits on the table nearby. Warm indoor lighting. Kitchen or dining room setting with windows showing daylight outside. Scene conveys preparation and planning. No text readable in the image.

Horizontal flowchart with six steps connected by arrows flowing left to right. Step one: compass icon with label Research Route. Step two: cloud icon with label Check Weather. Step three: clipboard icon with label Write Plan. Step four: phone icon with label Share with Contact. Step five: wooden sign icon with label Register at Trailhead. Step six: boot icon with label Hit the Trail. Clean flat design on a light outdoor-green background. Each step is a rounded rectangle with an icon above and short label below. Simple arrow connectors between steps. No additional text or decorations.

Vertical numbered list showing seven survival priorities from top to bottom. Each priority displayed as a horizontal bar with a number, small icon, and label. 1: brain icon, STOP. 2: medical cross icon, First Aid. 3: shelter icon, Shelter. 4: flame icon, Fire. 5: starburst icon, Signaling. 6: water drop icon, Water. 7: leaf icon, Food. Bars transition in color from urgent red at top to calm green at bottom. A bold downward arrow runs along the left side indicating priority order. Clean minimal design on a light background. No additional text beyond the seven labels.

Simple square diagram showing the four steps of box breathing. The square has four equal sides. Left side labeled Inhale 4 seconds with an upward arrow. Top side labeled Hold 4 seconds with a rightward arrow. Right side labeled Exhale 4 seconds with a downward arrow. Bottom side labeled Hold 4 seconds with a leftward arrow. Arrows show clockwise flow around the square. Simple calm blue color scheme on a white background. Clean typography with generous spacing. No additional decorations or imagery.

A teenager in a clean Scout uniform sitting calmly on a mossy fallen log in a quiet forest. Hands resting on knees in a relaxed posture. Expression is thoughtful and composed, not distressed. Late afternoon golden light filters through tall deciduous trees creating warm dappled light. Forest floor covered with ferns and fallen leaves. Scene conveys calm determination and self-control. No other people visible. No text or branding.

A personal first aid kit opened on a camp picnic table showing neatly organized supplies. Red waterproof zippered pouch with multiple clear ziplock bags inside containing: assorted adhesive bandages in one bag, gauze pads and roller gauze in another, small bottles of antiseptic and antibiotic ointment packets in a third, elastic bandage and moleskin sheets, tweezers and safety pins visible. Everything clearly organized and accessible. Outdoor setting with natural light. No text or labels visible in the image.

A personal survival kit in a hard-sided waterproof case opened flat on a granite rock surface in an outdoor setting. Contents visible and organized: ferro rod with attached striker, small signal mirror, bright orange whistle on a cord, bundle of tan paracord, folded metallic silver space blanket, small container of water purification tablets, duct tape wrapped tightly around a short pencil, folded heavy-duty black trash bag, small aluminum foil packet, and a compact LED flashlight. Items nestle snugly in the case. Blurred forest background.

A teenager in rain gear rigging a simple tarp shelter between two trees in a rainy forest. The blue tarp is angled to shed water, tied with paracord to tree trunks. Rain is visible falling in the background. A small area under the tarp is dry with a pile of gathered firewood. The ground is wet with puddles. Dark overcast sky visible through the canopy. Scene conveys practical shelter-building in difficult conditions. No text or branding.

A clear diagram showing one person floating in open water wearing an orange life jacket in the HELP position. The person's knees are drawn up to their chest and arms are crossed tightly over their chest. Three labeled callout boxes point to key features: one points to the crossed arms labeled Arms crossed over chest, one points to the drawn-up knees labeled Knees drawn to chest, one points to the life jacket labeled Life jacket keeps head above water. Blue water surrounds the figure. Clean instructional style with white background above the waterline.

Three-panel horizontal diagram showing the cold weather layering system. Left panel: simple body silhouette wearing a fitted base layer with the label Moisture-Wicking Base Layer below. Center panel: body silhouette wearing a puffy mid layer with the label Insulating Mid Layer below. Right panel: body silhouette wearing a hooded shell jacket with the label Waterproof Outer Shell below. Each silhouette is a simple, clean illustration on a white background. Arrows between panels suggest the layers stack together. Color progression from light blue to medium blue to dark blue.

Three-column comparison showing proper outdoor clothing for different conditions. Left column: figure dressed for cold weather in layered system with insulated jacket, warm hat, gloves, and boots, labeled Cold Weather. Center column: figure dressed for hot weather in light-colored loose long-sleeve shirt, wide-brimmed hat, and lightweight pants, labeled Hot Weather. Right column: figure dressed for wet weather in waterproof rain jacket, rain pants, and waterproof boots, labeled Wet Weather. Simple illustrated style with clean backgrounds. Each figure stands on a subtle color-coded ground matching their condition.

A clear instructional diagram showing the proper bear bag hanging technique. Two trees shown about fifteen feet apart. A rope runs from one tree trunk over a high branch to a suspended stuff sack, then continues to be tied off on a separate tree. The bag hangs between the trees. Three measurement labels shown: one indicating 10 feet from the ground to the bag, one indicating 4 feet from the nearest tree trunk to the bag, and one showing the rope tied to a separate anchor tree. Simple clean illustration style with green tree silhouettes on a white background. No additional decorations.

A well-organized backcountry campsite at dusk showing proper animal-proofing. A bear canister sits on the ground about fifty feet from a small tent. A clean cooking area with a camp stove is set up on a flat rock away from the sleeping area. A food bag hangs from a rope between two trees in the background. Sealed trash bags sit near the bear canister. The campsite is clean with no food scraps visible. Forest surrounds the clearing. Warm twilight sky. No people visible. No text or branding.

Four-stage horizontal illustration showing lean-to shelter construction from left to right. Stage one: a single long ridge pole propped at an angle with one end resting in a tree crotch about three feet high and the other on the ground. Stage two: shorter support branches leaned against the ridge pole at regular intervals. Stage three: a thin layer of leaves and debris placed over the branch framework. Stage four: completed shelter with a very thick layer of leaves and debris covering the entire structure, with a visible bed of leaves inside for ground insulation. Clean instructional illustration style with numbered labels for each stage. Forest background suggested with simple tree silhouettes.

Three-panel horizontal illustration showing cross-section views of three snow shelter types. Left panel: snow trench with a figure lying inside a narrow trench cut in snow, covered with branches laid across the top, with a ventilation gap. Center panel: quinzhee showing a hollowed-out snow mound with a small entrance tunnel, domed interior ceiling, raised sleeping platform, and a ventilation hole poked through the top with a stick. Right panel: snow cave dug into a hillside snowdrift showing a downward-sloping entrance tunnel leading up to a domed sleeping chamber carved higher than the entrance. Each panel has a simple label below identifying the shelter type. Clean technical illustration style with snow shown in white and blue tones.

A teenager in work clothes gathering a large armful of dry fallen leaves from the forest floor and carrying them toward a partially constructed lean-to shelter frame visible in the background. The shelter frame shows a ridge pole propped against a tree with several support branches in place. A thick bed of leaves is already piled inside the shelter for ground insulation. Deciduous forest in autumn with fallen leaves covering the ground. Afternoon sunlight. Active, purposeful body language. No Scout uniform in this image since the activity would soil it.

A completed debris lean-to shelter at twilight in a forest clearing. The shelter has a very thick covering of leaves and forest debris over its branch framework, appearing solid and weather-resistant. Inside the shelter entrance, a thick bed of dry leaves is visible for sleeping. A small campfire burns nearby, casting warm orange light on the shelter and surrounding trees. Stars are beginning to appear in a deep blue sky visible through the treetops. Atmospheric and inviting scene. No people visible. No text or branding.

Close-up photograph of two hands using a ferro rod and steel striker to create a shower of bright white-orange sparks directed into a tinder bundle. The tinder bundle sits on the ground and consists of shredded cedar bark and dry grass formed into a birds-nest shape. Behind the tinder bundle, a small teepee fire lay of pencil-thin sticks is prepared and ready. The person wears outdoor clothing. Forest floor visible. Dramatic lighting from the sparks contrasting with the shaded surroundings. Sharp focus on the sparks and tinder.

Educational illustration showing three groups of fire fuel arranged left to right by increasing size. Left group labeled Tinder: small pile of shredded bark fibers, a cotton ball, and a wisp of dry grass. Center group labeled Kindling: a bundle of pencil-thick dry twigs and small sticks. Right group labeled Fuel Wood: several wrist-thick branches and one split log piece. Each group sits on a subtle ground line. Clean natural-history illustration style with warm earthy tones. Simple labels beneath each group. Arrow at bottom showing progression from small to large. White background.

A tall column of thick white smoke rising from a fire in a small forest clearing into a clear blue sky. The fire is built with green branches on top of burning dry wood to create maximum smoke. The smoke column is visible for a long distance, contrasting sharply against the dark green forest canopy. The clearing is open enough that the smoke column rises unobstructed. Midday lighting. No people visible. Scene demonstrates how a signal fire would appear to search aircraft overhead.

Clean reference chart showing five ground-to-air distress signals arranged in a single horizontal row. From left to right: a large V shape labeled Require Assistance, a large X shape labeled Require Medical Help, a single straight vertical line labeled Serious Injury, an arrow pointing right labeled Traveling This Direction, and two L shapes side by side labeled All Is Well. Each symbol is rendered in dark brown on a light tan background. Symbols are bold and clear with generous spacing between them. Simple sans-serif labels beneath each. No border, title, or additional decorations.

Three-panel comparison showing water treatment methods. Left panel: a metal pot sitting on rocks over a small campfire with steam rising from boiling water, labeled Boiling. Center panel: a hand dropping a small purification tablet into a clear water bottle, labeled Chemical Treatment. Right panel: a squeeze-style water filter being used to filter water from a dirty bag into a clean cup, labeled Filtration. Each panel has a clean background and clear, simple composition. Labels appear below each panel.

A teenager in a clean Scout uniform kneeling beside a clear mountain stream flowing over smooth rocks in a forested valley. The Scout is filling a water bottle from the stream. Tall evergreen trees line both banks. The water is clear enough to see the rocky bottom. Mountain ridges are visible in the distance through the valley. Bright natural daylight with some clouds. Scene conveys a typical backcountry water collection scenario. No text or branding.

Two-row comparison chart showing dangerous plant look-alikes. Top row: Wild Carrot on the left with its flat white flower cluster and hairy green stem, next to Poison Hemlock on the right with similar white flowers but smooth stem with purple blotches highlighted. A clear label beneath each plant and a warning symbol between them. Bottom row: Elderberry branch on the left with clusters of dark purple berries, next to Water Hemlock on the right with similar-looking berries and leaves. Labels beneath each. Clean botanical illustration style on white background with thin dividing lines between panels.

A park ranger in a green and tan uniform standing at a scenic mountain overlook. The ranger holds binoculars in one hand and surveys a vast landscape of forested mountain ridges stretching to the horizon. Blue sky with scattered white clouds. The overlook has a simple wooden railing. The scene conveys the scope and appeal of wilderness-related careers. Golden hour lighting. No text, logos, or branding visible.

A group of four volunteers in work clothes and gloves maintaining a forest trail. Two are clearing brush with hand tools while one moves a fallen branch and another rakes the trail surface smooth. They wear work gloves, boots, and practical outdoor clothing. Dense forest surrounds the trail. Backpacks and water bottles sit along the trail edge. Collaborative, purposeful body language. Midday forest light filtering through canopy. No text or branding.

Night sky illustration showing the Big Dipper constellation with seven stars connected by lines forming the familiar dipper shape. Two pointer stars at the lip of the dipper are connected by a dotted line that extends upward about five times the distance between them to reach Polaris, the North Star, which is shown as a brighter star. The Little Dipper is faintly visible with Polaris at the end of its handle. Stars rendered as bright points against a deep navy blue sky. Labels identify Big Dipper, Pointer Stars, and Polaris. Clean astronomical illustration style.
